newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Bank aims to boost ROE to 7.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Bank aims to boost ROE to 7.0 pct.

text.p: Asahi Bank Ltd said on Friday it aims to boost its return-on-equity (ROE) ratio to more than 7.0 percent in a three-year programme that started on April 1.
The bank's ROE ratio -- a gauge of efficiency in the use of capital -- was estimated at about 3.0 percent in 1996/97, which ended on March 31, a bank spokesman said.
The bank also said in a statement that it aims to boost its international capital adequacy ratio more than 10 percent in the programme from about 8.7 percent at the end of March.
The programme is aimed at enabling Asahi to cope with "Big Bang" reforms to liberalise Japan's financial markets by 2001 by keeping its focus on retail banking business in Japan.
